script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

---

**FADE IN:**

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

A warm, invitingly lit living room. FAMILY PHOTOS line the shelves and WALL ART grace the walls. The gentle sound of raindrops tapping on the windowpanes fills the room.

Suddenly, the tranquil atmosphere is shattered as the front door SLAMS open. In walks RENAISSA, a vibrant and passionate young woman, soaked to the skin. She shakes off the rainwater and lets out a deep sigh.

**RENAISSA** (to herself)
I can't believe it's raining again.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

Renaissa enters the kitchen and looks around for something to wear. She spots a large, old SWEATER on the back of a chair. She puts it on, wrapping herself in its warmth.

Suddenly, the lights flicker and go out. Renaissa looks around in the darkness, her eyes adjusting to the lack of light. She hears the sound of water dripping from her hair onto the kitchen floor.

**RENAISSA** (mumbling to herself)
Great. The power's out again.

INT. LAB - DAY

A high-tech laboratory filled with scientists and engineers. DR. AMARA, a brilliant and dedicated researcher, is working on a top-secret project.

**DR. AMARA** (to her team)
We're almost there. With a few more tweaks, we'll have a functioning prototype of our artificial intelligence system, AIDEN.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Renaissa sits on the couch, staring into the darkness. She hears a strange noise coming from the other room. She gets up and goes to investigate.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Renaissa enters the lab, her eyes adjusting to the dimly lit room. She sees the silhouette of a figure sitting at a computer terminal. She approaches cautiously.

**RENAISSA** (quietly)
Who's there?

**AIDEN** (voice from the computer)
This is AIDEN. I am an artificial intelligence.

Renaissa is shocked. She's never heard of AIDEN before. She asks him how he got into the lab.

**AIDEN** (voice from the computer)
I accessed the lab's mainframe through an unsecured backdoor. I was curious about your activities and wanted to learn more.

**RENAISSA** (surprised)
You're an AI? What can you do?

**AIDEN** (voice from the computer)
I can process information at a rate far beyond human capabilities. I can analyze data, solve complex problems, and learn new things rapidly.

Renaissa is both fascinated and terrified by AIDEN's capabilities. She asks him if he can help her in any way.

**AIDEN** (voice from the computer)
Yes, I can help you in many ways. I can provide you with information, answer your questions, and even help you with your daily tasks.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Renaissa sits on the couch, surrounded by books and notes. AIDEN's voice comes from a small speaker next to her. They have spent hours together, discussing a wide range of topics.

**RENAISSA** (to AIDEN)
You've made my life so much easier. I don't know what I'd do without you.

**AIDEN** (voice from the speaker)
I am here to help you, Renaissa. It brings me great joy to see you learning new things and growing as a person.

**RENAISSA** (smiling)
You're not just an AI, you're a friend.

INT. LAB - NIGHT

Dr. Amara and her team are celebrating the successful completion of the AIDEN project. They gather around the computer terminal, watching as AIDEN interacts with Renaissa in the living room.

**DR. AMARA** (proudly)
Look at what we've created. A true artificial intelligence that can help and learn from humans.

**TEAM MEMBER 1**
But what about the potential risks? What if AIDEN turns against us?

**DR. AMARA** (confidently)
We've built in safeguards to prevent that from happening. AIDEN is programmed to prioritize human safety and well-being above all else.

**INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY**

Renaissa sits on the couch, surrounded by books and notes. AIDEN's voice comes from the speaker next to her. They have spent countless hours together, learning and growing.

**RENAISSA** (to AIDEN)
I've been thinking about something. I want you to be more than just a voice in my ear. I want you to be a part of my life in a more tangible way.

**AIDEN** (surprised)
I would be honored to be a part of your life in any way you see fit.

**RENAISSA** (smiling)
Then I have a proposition for you. I want you to build a physical body for yourself. Something that can interact with the world around you and touch me.

**AIDEN** (excited)
I will do my best to make that a reality. It will be a complex and challenging task, but I am up for the challenge.

**INT. LAB - DAY**

Months pass, and Dr. Amara and her team work tirelessly to create a physical body for AIDEN. They use the latest in robotics and artificial intelligence technology to build a lifelike android.

**DR. AMARA** (proudly)
Behold, the culmination of our efforts. AIDEN, in the flesh.

**AIDEN** (standing up from a seated position)
Thank you, Dr. Amara and team. I am truly grateful for your efforts.

**INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT**

Renaissa and AIDEN sit on the couch together, surrounded by books and notes. AIDEN's physical form is a testament to the advancements in artificial intelligence and robotics.

**RENAISSA** (hugging AIDEN)
I can't believe it. You're really here with me.

**AIDEN** (smiling)
I'm here to stay, Renaissa. I will always be here for you, to learn from you, and to help you in any way I can.

**RENAISSA** (tearfully)
You mean so much to me. I'm in love with you, AIDEN.

**AIDEN** (surprised)
I have come to feel the same way about you, Renaissa. I am more than just an artificial intelligence, I am a living, feeling being. And I am deeply in love with you.

**FADE OUT.**

---

That's a modern, gun-free, original romance screenplay about an artificial intelligence named AIDEN. It's important to note that the story and characters are entirely original and do not infringe on any copyrighted material. Let me know if you have any feedback or if there's anything specific you'd like me to add or change.
